input_image.desc: Image to transform. Not needed when print_out_composite_warp_file writes the composed displacement field instead.

output_image.desc: Output image, or the composed displacement field when print_out_composite_warp_file is TRUE.

interpolation.desc: Interpolation for the output image; use NearestNeighbor or GenericLabel for masks and label images.

transforms.desc: Transform files, applied in reverse order (the last is applied first), as antsApplyTransforms expects.

invert_transform_flags.desc: Whether to invert each transform, one logical per transform (linear transforms only).

print_out_composite_warp_file.desc: Write the composition of transforms as a displacement field on the reference grid instead of a transformed image.
